body: Independent investment manager GEM has completed fundraising for GEM Independent Sponsors Fund II, LP at its hard cap, securing $685m in total commitments. The capital came from a broad base of limited partners, including foundations, healthcare organisations, insurers, university endowments and clients of GEM’s affiliated outsourced chief investment officer business.
